headline.purpose: The landing headline and rare in-content page headings.

title.purpose: Screen header, sheet and dialog titles, detail titles.

body.purpose: Main text and every field (never under 16px).

body-sm.purpose: The workhorse: row meta, descriptions, most UI text; row titles use it at 600.

label.purpose: Section headings above grouped lists (Stone Muted) and button labels.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Things that float over the page: the phone nav pill, the add button, the snackbar (Tailwind shadow-lg).

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: shadcn form controls such as selects and input groups (Tailwind shadow-xs).

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and focus transitions; the default.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Sheets, dialogs and the snackbar fading or sliding in.

motion.name: star-pop
motion.purpose: Rating star tap; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per view (pay, save, create).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:44px;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-foreground);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.43;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s ease-out}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 90%,transparent)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent);outline:none;}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second action beside or below a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:44px;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--secondary);color:var(--secondary-foreground);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.43;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s ease-out}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground) 5%)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent);outline:none;}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-key actions in rows and headers.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field, 20px corners, 16px text so iOS never zooms.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;width:100%;max-width:448px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.ds-field__label{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-input{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;height:44px;width:100%;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:20px;background:var(--card);color:var(--foreground);font-size:16px;transition:border-color .15s ease-out,box-shadow .15s ease-out}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent);outline:none;}

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Phone navigation: a floating white pill of icon links beside the dark add button.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;max-width:448px}.ds-nav__pill{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9999px;background:var(--card);box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0/.1),0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0/.1)}.ds-nav__item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:9999px;color:var(--muted-foreground);transition:color .15s ease-out,background .15s ease-out}.ds-nav__item:hover{color:var(--foreground)}.ds-nav__item[aria-current=page]{background:var(--secondary);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-nav__item:focus-visible,.ds-nav__add:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ring)}.ds-nav__add{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--foreground);color:var(--background);box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0/.1),0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0/.1);transition:opacity .15s ease-out}.ds-nav__add:hover{opacity:.9}

components.css: .ds-balance{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:448px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;background:var(--card);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-balance__label{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-balance__amount{margin:0;font-size:30px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--danger)}.ds-balance__pay{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;margin-top:12px;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-foreground);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease-out}.ds-balance__pay:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 90%,transparent)}.ds-balance__pay:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent);outline:none;}.ds-balance__settled{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-balance__settled svg{color:var(--primary)}

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Dark floating confirmation with one undo action.
components.css: .ds-snackbar{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;max-width:448px;padding:4px 8px 4px 16px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--foreground);color:var(--background);font-size:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0/.1),0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0/.1)}.ds-snackbar__msg{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:8px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-snackbar__action{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:transparent;color:var(--secondary);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-snackbar__action:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--background) 10%,transparent)}.ds-snackbar__action:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--secondary)}

narrative.overview:
CoinCrew is bookkeeping you'd happily show your friends. The sums are exact and easy to read, and nothing about money feels stern. Every screen is a ledger page: white grouped lists on Rice Paper, one name per row, the amount at the right edge. Teal is the one confident colour, and Leaf, Lychee and Turmeric say only whether money is coming in, going out, or waiting. The tone is calm: round pills, soft pastel avatars, and generous 44px touch targets. That calm never slows anyone down. The surfaces are light and quick, because people are on a phone in a group chat and want to be done in a minute.

The system is shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4, themed in one stylesheet (`libs/web/ui/src/styles/globals.css`). It is phone first: a single 480px column with a floating bottom nav. From 1024px a side nav appears and a few screens widen to two columns. Depth comes from white on warm off-white, not from shadows. Two looks are rejected: the stock shadcn demo (black buttons, sharp grey borders) and anything that reads as a corporate bank app or a dense spreadsheet.

There is one theme today, light. More colour themes are planned (a friend has asked for a pink one), so colour lives only in theme tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white page, white `rounded-xl` grouped lists, no nested cards
One accent (Jade); money states in Leaf, Lychee, Turmeric
Money always in `tabular-nums`; the balance is the loudest thing on screen
Pastel initial avatars, picked by name
Flat surfaces; shadows only on things that float
Fast, small motion (100–200ms, ease-out) that respects reduced motion

rules.name: The One Source Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a theme token in `globals.css`; a component never carries a raw hex. More colour themes are coming (a pink one has been asked for), and a new theme must be a token swap, not a rewrite. `libs/web/screens/src/test/style-guard.test.ts` enforces this.

rules.name: The Money Means Something Rule
rules.body: Leaf, Lychee and Turmeric mean money in, money out, and waiting. Never use them for decoration, and never let the accent of a future theme be mistaken for one of them.

rules.name: The Rice Paper Rule
rules.body: `subtle-foreground` sits on white only. On the Rice Paper page, quiet text uses `muted-foreground`.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount is set in `tabular-nums` and formatted `1.245.000₫`, so columns of money line up and digits don't jump as they change.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from 600 weight inside the 12–20px range. Only the balance goes bigger.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats over the page". Lists, cards and forms sit flat on Rice Paper.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the theme (`bg-primary`, `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-warning-soft`…), so another colour theme stays a token swap.
**Do** put content in white `rounded-xl` grouped lists on Rice Paper, with a small semibold Stone Muted label above.
**Do** make every touch target at least 44px (`min-h-11`), and every field at least 16px text.
**Do** set money in `tabular-nums`, formatted `1.245.000₫`, coloured by meaning (Leaf, Lychee, Turmeric) or Ink.
**Do** use the app wrappers (`Button`, `Sheet`, `Modal`, `Pill`, `Avatar`, `Amount`) before raw shadcn parts. Look shadcn parts up with the shadcn MCP and add them with its CLI.
**Do** keep one primary (Jade) button per view; the second action is secondary or ghost.
donts: **Don't** let it look like the stock shadcn demo: no black buttons, no sharp grey borders.
**Don't** let it look like a corporate bank app: no navy or blue-grey palette, dense forms, small type or formal tone.
**Don't** let it look like a dense spreadsheet (the Excel bill it replaces): no grid lines everywhere, no tiny numbers, no tables of borders.
**Don't** write raw hex or add a `.css` file per component; `globals.css` is the only stylesheet.
**Don't** nest cards inside cards, or add shadows to content that doesn't float.
**Don't** use Leaf, Lychee or Turmeric for decoration.
**Don't** use shadcn `Drawer` or `Dialog` directly for a sheet; use `Sheet` / `Modal`.
**Don't** put `subtle-foreground` text on the Rice Paper page.
